history.action: Color pipeline overhaul: gamut/HDR auto-detect, device profiles (bravia/mac/wide_gamut_hdr), CCT cold/warm split, bounded palette hold, OLED true-black, per-HDR-type tone curves, FP16 BT.2020-PQ capture path; mirrored CCT split + auto-detect to Python desktop; added macOS PyInstaller spec + build_macos.sh.
Built release Android APK with all color changes.

Researched on-device color sync feasibility on Bravia 8 II. Verdict: pure on-TV app cannot capture DRM streaming (black frames) or external HDMI/tuner (separate hardware video plane). TV is Android 12/API 31, so FP16 BT.2020-PQ path (API 34+) will not engage; capture is 8-bit SDR. No HDR10+ (DV/HDR10/HLG only). Viable full-coverage paths: external HDMI sync box (companion device running our pipeline) or camera; on-TV app is limited to non-DRM content.

Built BOTH capture modes. Extracted shared ColorSyncEngine.kt (single source of truth for color math + UDP). Refactored ScreenCaptureService to delegate to it. Added PlayerActivity.kt (ExoPlayer USB media player + TextureView.getBitmap frame grab -> engine) for non-DRM local USB playback (sidesteps MediaProjection/secure-surface). Added SyncBridge, Media3 deps (1.4.1), manifest entry, MainActivity pickMedia/playMedia/stopMedia (SAF), Flutter mode toggle + USB controls. Clean release build.

Verified 9 cross-session R&D bug claims (BUG-01/02/03/06/07/08/09/10/13/14) against current repo. Verdict: 0 of 9 present — all already guarded here (threading.Lock in screen_sync.py, _resolve_monitor, crop size guards, gain clamp 0.70-1.0, dxcam None guards, websocket snapshot-before-broadcast, default-arg lambda binding). R&D fixes were against the earlier sandbox copy. Read-only; no code changed. Open follow-up: confirm V2 debug_snapshot read/write can't tear.

Implemented + verified 3 latency/efficiency wins (option b), one at a time: (1) IP_TOS IPTOS_LOWDELAY socket flag in fast_udp_sender._connect (read back 0x10); (2) replaced PIL resize with strided numpy sampling in non-default extractors weighted/histogram/kmeans (screen_sync_v2.py) via new _stride_sample_rgb helper, removed now-unused PIL import; (3) quantized packet-cache channels to nearest 8 (_QUANTIZE_STEP, max 4/255 error, lit->off guard) collapsing jittered streams 1203->12 cache entries. All verified with synthetic tests + py_compile + package import. Global behavior notes: (3) adds <=4/255 banding for everyone (tunable, set _QUANTIZE_STEP=1 to disable); (2) only affects non-auto algorithms.

Architecture research (code audit + sourced prior-art sweep: Hyperion/Hue Entertainment/WLED/WiZ/Oklab) then implemented Phase 1 + Phase 2 items on BOTH platforms: (1) scene-cut detector (luma-hist TV>0.30 AND inst. diff>0.10) with one-frame snap bypassing smoothing/delta; (2) frame-rate-independent settling smoothing (smoothing setting -> settle window, 0.2=160ms, 95% conv at window, epsilon snap kills EMA tail; was ~640ms to 90%); (3) Oklab perceptual lerp + delta gate x400 scale (fixes gray-dip AND closes redmean-vs-Manhattan platform divergence); (4) linear-light mean accumulation in extractors (weights stay gamma-tuned); (5) trilinear interpolation in 33-cube LUT (was nearest-lattice +-4); (6) V2 gains 1.5s force-refresh (Kotlin parity); (7) new scripts/probe_wiz_rate.py measures real rate cap + dimming-vs-RGB latency (dimming-split gated on its results). 93 pytest passed, ruff clean, APK rebuilt 46.5MB.

history.action: Content-adaptive mapping + profiles + device targeting. ROOT-CAUSE FIX for Bravia DV symptoms: capture-space binding — Android MediaProjection/TextureView (and Windows-SDR DXCam) buffers are ALREADY sRGB SDR; auto mode no longer applies rec2020 matrix + tone curve on top (double-processing caused too-bright/too-dim/wrong-hue); macOS keeps P3 (verified exception). Neutral/B&W pipeline: scene avg-saturation -> desaturate to true gray + suppress color boost + skip palette hold; brightness-follow scales output + floor with scene luma; true black -> bulb OFF (state:false). Fixed pre-existing LUT white-gate bug (channel gains faked sat 0.17 on pure gray -> whites leaked to RGB LEDs) + added 256-entry gray-ramp LUT (trilinear smears the neutral diagonal); near-white now (12,12,18,c160,w6). Sync profiles auto/cinema(settle x1.7, delta 8)/action(x0.45, delta 2, no hold) across config/V2/engine/extras. GUIs: Flutter Sync-Feel segmented control + brightness-follow switch + scene diagnostics; Windows CTk Sync Feel segmented + follow checkbox + Auto(detect) color source (was missing -> auto could not round-trip). Device research -> docs/device-display-matrix.md (Bravia 8 II, Tab S9U, S21-S25, MacBook Air M4 (IPS not OLED), Vivobook 16X OLED; Windows HDR-on 8-bit flagged unsupported-for-colorimetry). 93 pytest passed, ruff clean, APK rebuilt.

history.action: 'Sync not working' triage -> THREE stacked root causes found & fixed with live on-machine testing. (1) Android APK: black-DRM capture + new black->OFF turned bulb off permanently; fixed with 0.7s persistence + captureLooksBlack flag + orange DRM banner; projection-setup errors surfaced; status heartbeat on static screens. (2) Windows source: dxcam video-mode get_latest_frame() blocks forever on static desktops + stop() join timeout tears camera down under stuck thread poisoning restarts; GPUCaptureManager rewritten non-blocking (per-call grab + cached-frame-on-unchanged); verified 3x restart cycles + REAL bulb end-to-end (192.168.1.6, payload delivered, 0 drops). (3) Frozen EXE: WizLight.spec excludes cv2 but dxcam's default RGB processor imports cv2 at grab time -> every grab raised in EXE; ALSO mss fallback was main-thread-created but sync-thread-used (GDI thread-affinity) -> silent 0 frames. Fixed: dxcam output_color=BGRA (no cv2) + own slice + release-on-probe-failure; mss lazy-init inside sync thread. Proven via new packaging/FrozenDiag.spec console diagnostic: frozen engine frames=13, dxcam active, bulb reachable. 94 tests, production EXE rebuilt.

history.action: Map-accuracy test for 2 user videos (RGB/CMYK test pattern + Bond dark title seq). Tested the mapping FUNCTION with exact input colors (can't decode YouTube frames). map_rgb verified accurate (hue <5deg, secondaries preserved, no white leak). Found real bug: brightness_follow judged scene brightness by perceptual luma -> full-intensity saturated blue dimmed -45% (0,0,255->140), red -18%. Fixed by switching brightness_follow to VALUE (avg max-channel) in screen_sync_v2.py (_scene_stats now returns value; _brightness_factor(avg_value)) + ColorSyncEngine.kt (avgValue). Verified blue/red now full, dark scenes still dim, black->off intact. 94 pytest, ruff clean. EXE + APK rebuilt. Documented non-code residual causes: WiZ LED gamut vs QD-OLED (needs camera cal), single-bulb averaging of multi-color patterns, desktop-LUT vs Android-basis-projection parity gap.

Codebase audit (subagent) found desktop<->Android parity drift; fixed 3 in Kotlin (5-frame motion avg, aligned motion divisors, ported adaptive_color_boost). Then LUT UNIFICATION (#6, biggest color gap): baked desktop 33^3 RGBCW LUT + 256 gray ramp to assets/wiz_rgbcw_lut_v1.bin via scripts/export_lut_for_android.py; Kotlin loadLut + mapViaLut trilinear replaces hue-basis projection (basis kept as fallback), per-device cool-bias applied post-hoc. Verified: Python replica of Kotlin trilinear vs desktop map_rgb = 0 max channel diff across 4000 colors -> Android bulb payloads now IDENTICAL to desktop. APK 46.6MB built with asset bundled. Deferred: #4 auto-extractor palette stage, #5 palette-hold, #7 cut-threshold retune, #8 zone stats.

Knocked out the 4 remaining deferred parity items. #4: ported desktop palette-candidate/match/balance stage to Kotlin (paletteCandidates + selectPaletteMatch + paletteBalanceScore + perceptualColorDistance redmean) and wired into extractCinematicSingleColor + extractBalancedAutoColor to mirror desktop extract_cinematic_single_color / extract_dominant_auto; caught a truncation bug (candidate avg must .toInt not roundToInt to match desktop int(np.clip)). #5: removed the palette-hold frame cap (18/24/36) so applyCinematicPaletteHold matches desktop exactly (bounded feedback blend converges/releases smoothly; cap caused a hue pop on long calm scenes). #7: desktop MotionDetector uses resolution-aware stride (width//320) so the cut histogram stays ~57k samples after the 640px downscale (fixed ::8 left it too sparse for the 0.30 threshold). #8: Kotlin scene stats average ALL grid regions, not just left, so zone-mode neutral/brightness/black reflect the whole frame. Verified: palette selected-color 0/400 mismatch vs desktop, balance-delta 0.0000; cut detector quiet on still/pan + fires on hard cut; 94 pytest pass; APK 46.6MB built clean.

PC video mapping audit + brightness redesign + de-bloat. Root cause of 'video colors not mapped': colors were sent at the scene's low RGB magnitude so LEDs ran at 30-60% drive (muddy dim hue). Redesign: value-normalize color to full drive, brightness rides setPilot dimming separately. Two modes per user: brightness_mode=follow (dimming tracks scene value, floor slider, near-black taper, black->off) and constant (dimming pinned at sync_brightness, black holds last color). Loop resends when dimming moves >=5. GUI: Brightness Mode segmented control + Constant Brightness slider, deleted the lines that stomped saved use_gpu/adaptive/predictive/algorithm each launch, added capture-looks-black status hint (DRM/overlay video captures black). De-bloat: removed alexa_bridge, websocket_server, CLI serve/alexa, fauxmo+websockets deps from requirements/pyproject/all specs, dead v1 ScreenSync class (506->377 lines), alexa docs. Verified: truth harness 8 frames x 2 modes all correct, 99 pytest (5 new), import smoke. EXE rebuild + live-bulb run pending.

history.action: Pursued the deferred physics-based colorimetric model research item (same-day continuation, user said 'let's pursue it right now'). Built a real 5-primary (RGBCW) / 4-primary (RGBW) additive LED-mixing model: fetched the verified Wyman/Sloan/Shirley 2013 multi-lobe Gaussian CIE 1931 CMF fit from its published source repo (not memory), added spectral integration (led_gaussian_xyz for the 625/530/455nm color LEDs, blackbody_xyz for the CCT-based whites) + linear-domain Oklab/XYZ helpers to color_science.py. New src/core/bulb_physical_model.py solves the EXACT LED-mixing equation per color (all C(N,3) triangle solves, proven complete via zonotope decomposition) instead of the heuristic's channel-gain-and-threshold guessing, with Oklab-based hue-preserving compression for out-of-gamut targets, fully vectorized for LUT-build speed (33^3 grid: 6.7s naive -> 0.17-0.32s batched). Wired into BulbColorProfile.mixing_model ('heuristic' default UNCHANGED | 'physical' opt-in) and BulbGamutMapper (dispatches; heuristic path renamed with zero lines changed, verified byte-identical). Found and fixed a real modeling bug along the way (white_ratio is a blend-threshold knob, not a luminous-flux ratio -- using it starved white-channel usage) and a fragile tie-break (maximizing white usage picked exotic metamers like R=0 for skin tones; switched to minimize-total-drive, more robust). Honest finding surfaced to the user: the assumed LED primaries are MORE saturated than sRGB's own primaries, so exact colorimetric match dilutes vivid colors with white -- may look less vivid than the heuristic's near-direct pass-through; this can only be judged by the user trying it live against their real bulb, so it was NOT made the default and NOT yet exposed in the GUI. 25 new tests (CMF/primary plausibility, exact reconstruction, compression self-consistency, batch/single equivalence, RGBW+RGBCW, zero-regression-to-heuristic assertion). 128 pytest total, ruff clean.

Audited issue batches repaired across desktop transport/shutdown/capture/configuration, Android lifecycle/settings/output, experimental bounded solver, validators and packaging. Verified 178 safe Python tests, 9 Flutter tests, 3 Kotlin tests, lint, source parsing, generic LUT equality and fresh development builds. Device acceptance, Mac build, TV navigation, release signing and SDK license setup remain pending. Original dirty source and builds backed up.

Windows has persistent sidebar/status, keyboard page shortcuts, direct tuning jump and DPI-aware sizing. No new dependencies or color-pipeline changes. Verified 181 safe Python tests, final 8 affected GUI tests, 14 Flutter tests, lint, snapshots and fresh development builds. Physical remote/device acceptance remains pending.

Connectivity/latency/colour pass. Measured that the WiZ ESP25 bulb listens about once every 205 ms and stays responsive ~5 ms after it replies; added BulbLinkMonitor (keep-awake getPilot chain + delivery confirmation from replies, setting screen_sync.keep_awake, GUI 'Low-latency link'). Live: colour updates confirmed in ~18 ms median, 40/40, versus ~117 ms and 6/40 undelivered for a single datagram. Capture loop: early wake on a changed frame during slow adaptive intervals, time-based brightness smoothing that snaps on cuts and large steps, colour-jump snap for cuts the absolute-difference test misses, per-zone dimming. Discovery now broadcasts from every local interface (found Bulb 1 moved .10 -> .9) with GUI 'Add by IP'; profile queries retry once. Physical mixing model: LED luminance from current x typical lumens per mA (blue was modeled two-thirds as bright as red), white-LED current parsed from the bulb, output rescaled to full drive. 308 pytest pass, ruff clean. Not done: GPU-side capture downscale, Android parity for these changes, any measured colour calibration. Optical camera test still pending.
